recommendations/data.description: Emitted when product recommendations are loaded. This includes recommended products based on user behavior, cart contents, or product associations.

recommendations.description: Array of recommended products including product details, pricing, and recommendation scoring information.

recommendationType.description: The type of recommendation algorithm used (e.g., 'cross-sell', 'upsell', 'viewed-together', 'bought-together').

recommendations/error.description: Emitted when an error occurs during recommendation loading or processing.

error.description: Error details including message, code, and context about which recommendation operation failed.

recommendations/initialized.description: Emitted when the recommendations component completes initialization. This indicates the recommendation engine is ready to fetch and display product suggestions.
